message.content: {"caption":"A two-stage workflow shows an agent gaining a data-extraction skill after an incorrect answer and using it in the next iteration.","description":"Diagram of two successive iterations in an agent–proposer–skill-builder workflow. In Iteration 0, a question box asks, “What was the continuously compounded average annual growth rate in Seigniorage (in millions of nominal dollars) ...?” The adjacent skills/ box says “(empty).” Three circular nodes are arranged left to right: Base Agent (robot icon), Proposer (lightbulb icon), and Skill Builder (tool icon). Solid arrows point from Base Agent to Proposer and from Proposer to Skill Builder; neither arrow has a label. The Base Agent’s red AGENT OUTPUT card shows “final_answer = 7.8%,” a red cross with “0.0,” and “Ground truth: -6.3%.” The orange PROPOSED SKILL card says: “Create data-extraction-verification – a rigorous protocol for extracting numerical data from Treasury Bulletin tables.” A message-trace box below reports finding and verifying the 1955 value, cites “Table 5 – Seigniorage on Silver (cumulative from Jan 1, 1935),” gives the formula r = ln(V1955 / V1945) / 10, and ends with final_answer = 7.8%. A dashed downward arrow connects this stage to Iteration 1.\n\nIn Iteration 1, the question box asks, “What is the arithmetic mean of the Total Liabilities ...?” The skills/ panel contains a tree showing data-extraction-verification/, with SKILL.MD and scripts/ containing data_extraction.py. A small clock-like icon and dashed line accompany the label “skills available to agent”; a package icon beside the Base Agent is labeled “skills loaded.” The same three nodes appear in the same left-to-right order, again connected by solid right-pointing arrows without labels. The green AGENT OUTPUT card shows the data-extraction-verification skill, “final_answer = 990822.83,” a green check with “1.0,” and “Ground truth: 990822.83.” The bottom message trace says it found the relevant table, “SECTION I – Liabilities to Foreigners,” shows a Skill tool call using data-extraction-verification, and ends with final_answer = 990822.83.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
